import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

tickers = ['^GSPC', 'GC=F', 'CL=F', '^TNX', 'DX-Y.NYB']
periods = [
    ('2023-10-06', '2023-11-08'),
    ('2024-04-12', '2024-05-14')
]

results = {}
for start, end in periods:
    data = yf.download(tickers, start=start, end=end)['Close']
    results[f"{start}_to_{end}"] = data.to_dict()

print(results)
